note: Which page each URL of cornellcgs.org opens (SITE.md, 'The real repo'). One source for src/main.tsx, src/film-site.ts, scripts/stubs.mjs, scripts/vite-film-shell.mjs and scripts/film-check.mjs. 'games' are the React mini games, built from game-shell.html exactly as before the film site; their slugs mirror src/content.ts pageSlugs. 'film' are the film site's pages: 'path' is a URL that must keep working (a stub at /<path>/), 'route' is the film site's route (picker/site/router.js), 'section' the part of that page the old URL was about. 'canonical' is the path search engines are told to index for that route.
